section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study that investigated the relationship between specific executive functions (EFs) and various measures of creativity in 47 participants. The study found that working memory Updating predicted divergent thinking fluency, response Inhibition predicted real-world artistic creative achievements, and involvement in artistic professions was linked to better Common EF and mental set Shifting abilities. The findings suggest that different EFs predict creativity depending on its operational definition.
